searchText: **EIP 1559 Implementers' Call #7 in ~24hrs** **Time: Thursday Dec 3rd at 16:00 UTC** **Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/226** **Zoom: to be share here prior to the call** <@!636906092374261761> <@!332923501079953409> what is the current geth branch you are using for 1559? If there is a deep re-org where the BASEFEE is adjusted significantly, are all txs in the re-org repriced, fee wise? Wondering of potential cascading effects. I guess most txs would just not be executable if, say, basefee was priced upward too much <@!278762485497069569> by repriced, you mean the amount they pay out is adjusted? Hi <@!552133098075193354> here is branch https://github.com/vulcanize/go-ethereum/tree/1559_test <@!543900561460822016> Yes Forgot if the fee specified by client is the final fee or the max fee Got it, yeah ethereum txs would scale up to pay the basefee (if they can still afford it) Because if it's the max fee then there is room for it to increase if re-orged Txs specify the max amount they’re willing to pay and the tip is calculated dynamically
